runs.scenario: A qualifying attack is reported at a precisely identified location near Socotra’s western approaches. One reader treats the location as included under 'waters around Socotra'; another treats it as part of the expressly excluded Gulf of Aden. The criterion gives no boundary for the Socotra inclusion or rule for resolving an overlap.
